
  BOSON INFINITY v2.1.0 — Installation Guide
  ============================================

  QUICK INSTALL (Windows)
  -----------------------
  1. Double-click install.bat
  2. Edit %LOCALAPPDATA%\BosonInfinity\data\boson.env
  3. Run "Start Node.bat"
  4. Open http://localhost:8080/explorer

  MANUAL INSTALL (any OS)
  -----------------------
  1. Copy binaries to a directory in your PATH
  2. Create a data directory
  3. Copy boson.env.example to boson.env in the data directory
  4. Edit boson.env — set at minimum:
       BOSON_API_KEY=<64-char hex string>
       BOSON_TREASURY_ADDR=<40-char hex address>
  5. Run: boson-node

  BINARIES
  --------
  boson-node.exe    Full blockchain node (RPC + P2P + Mining + Explorer)
  boson-cli.exe     Command-line interface for querying the node
  boson-miner.exe   CPU miner (HTTP polling or WebSocket)
  boson-wallet.exe  Desktop wallet with encrypted key storage
  boson-oracle.exe  Energy oracle for cost-per-coin calculations

  CONFIGURATION (boson.env)
  -------------------------
  Required:
    BOSON_API_KEY           64-char hex API key for miner authentication
    BOSON_TREASURY_ADDR     40-char hex address for treasury (20% block reward)

  Optional:
    BOSON_P2P_TOKEN         P2P authentication token (production)
    BOSON_SEED_NODES        Comma-separated seed node URLs
    BOSON_RPC_PORT          RPC port (default: 8080)
    BOSON_P2P_PORT          P2P port (default: 8081)
    BOSON_DATA_DIR          Data directory (default: current dir)
    BOSON_WALLET_PASS       Wallet encryption passphrase
    BOSON_TLS_CERT          TLS certificate file path
    BOSON_TLS_KEY           TLS private key file path

  RUNNING A NODE
  --------------
  # Start node:
  boson-node

  # Check status:
  boson-cli status

  # View block explorer:
  http://localhost:8080/explorer

  # View Prometheus metrics:
  http://localhost:8080/metrics

  MINING
  ------
  # Set environment variables:
  set BOSON_NODE_URL=http://localhost:8080
  set BOSON_API_KEY=<your-api-key>
  set BOSON_WALLET=<your-40-hex-wallet-address>

  # Start CPU miner (HTTP polling):
  boson-miner

  # Start CPU miner (WebSocket — recommended):
  boson-miner --ws

  WALLET
  ------
  # Set passphrase for encrypted key storage:
  set BOSON_WALLET_PASS=YourStrongPassphrase

  # Start wallet GUI:
  boson-wallet

  # Opens http://localhost:8090 in your browser

  DOCKER
  ------
  docker build -t boson-node .
  docker run -p 8080:8080 -p 8081:8081 \
    -e BOSON_API_KEY=<key> \
    -e BOSON_TREASURY_ADDR=<addr> \
    boson-node

  API ENDPOINTS
  -------------
  GET  /health              Node health check
  GET  /explorer            Block explorer UI
  GET  /metrics             Prometheus metrics
  GET  /stats               Network statistics
  GET  /getWork             Mining work package
  POST /submitWork          Submit PoW solution
  WS   /ws/mining           WebSocket mining
  POST /tx/submit           Submit transaction
  GET  /tx/get?hash=        Transaction lookup
  GET  /tx/proof?hash=      Merkle inclusion proof
  GET  /account?addr=       Account balance
  GET  /address/txs?addr=   Transaction history
  GET  /block?height=       Block details
  GET  /chain?from=&limit=  Block list
  GET  /checkpoints         State checkpoints

  SUPPORT
  -------
